_comment: mem_region_mux is purely combinational (no clk port) -- CLOCK_PORT is nulled out so LibreLane doesn't try to constrain a nonexistent clock net.
_comment_die: mem_region_mux's cell area is tiny but its IO-pin count is huge (3x cpu_data_o_t/cpu_data_i_t record buses, ~318 pins) -- a utilization-driven floorplan undersizes the die perimeter for that many pins (IOPlacement PPL-0024: needs >=1068.48um perimeter). Force an explicit die big enough for the pin count, not just the cell area.
